# Perna & Abracht LLC

> A Pennsylvania-based law firm providing comprehensive legal services in personal injury, criminal defense, estate planning, real estate, and business litigation.

Perna & Abracht LLC is a Chester County law practice staffed by experienced attorneys with backgrounds in prosecution, criminal defense, and civil litigation. The firm combines courtroom expertise with community involvement to serve clients throughout Pennsylvania.

## Key Topics

- Personal Injury Law
- Criminal Defense
- Estate Planning
- Real Estate Law
- Business Litigation
- Pennsylvania Attorney
- Chester County
- Prosecutor Background
- Immigration Justice
- Divorce & Family Law
- Private Practice
- Community Involvement
- Perna & Abracht LLC

## Attorney Profiles

- [Michael Perna](https://pa4law.com/michael-perna): Partner specializing in personal injury, estate planning, real estate, and business litigation.
- [Ryan G. Borchik](https://pa4law.com/ryan-g-borchik): Attorney with prosecutor background in criminal defense and personal injury law.
